name: Western Superconducting Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Western Superconducting Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of superconducting materials, high-end titanium alloy materials, and high temperature alloy materials and applications in China and internationally. The company offers superconducting products, including titanium ingots, superconducting wires, niobium ingots, MgB2 wires, and superconducting magnets; high-end titanium alloy materials, such as rods and wires; and high-temperature alloy materials comprising deformed high-temperature alloys and high-temperature alloy master bars.
